Remove the P/Q reset switches so those nodes swing less, and resize: larger input pair and tail, smaller latch, reset and inverter devices. Predictions are calibrated to iteration-1 simulation.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Delay is 2x over and limited by integration (Win dominant). Removing the P/Q reset PMOS cuts their switched charge and capacitance; P/Q precharge to VDD-Vth through the latch NMOS. Larger diff pair and tail plus smaller latch, reset and inverter devices cut both delay and energy. Model gets a calibration factor."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "Win":   (6.0, 2.0, 16.0),   # differential pair width (um), L=0.15
    "Wtail": (5.0, 1.5, 14.0),   # clocked tail width
    "Wln":   (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),   # latch NMOS width
    "Wlp":   (0.7, 0.42, 3.0),   # latch PMOS width
    "Wrst":  (0.42, 0.42, 1.5),  # reset PMOS width
    "Winv":  (0.6, 0.42, 3.0),   # output inverter NMOS width (PMOS = 2x)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    L = 0.15
    VDD = 1.8
    dv = spec.get("dv", 0.002)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    Win, Wt, Wln, Wlp, Wr, Wi = p["Win"], p["Wtail"], p["Wln"], p["Wlp"], p["Wrst"], p["Winv"]

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")
    n.M("M0", "tail", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wt, L)
    n.M("M1", "P", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", Win, L)
    n.M("M2", "Q", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", Win, L)
    # cross-coupled latch; P/Q precharge to VDD-Vth through M3/M4 (no dedicated switches)
    n.M("M3", "xa", "xb", "P", "vss", "nfet", Wln, L)
    n.M("M4", "xb", "xa", "Q", "vss", "nfet", Wln, L)
    n.M("M5", "xa", "xb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wlp, L)
    n.M("M6", "xb", "xa", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wlp, L)
    n.M("M9", "xa", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    n.M("M10", "xb", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    n.M("M11", "outp", "xa", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wi, L)
    n.M("M12", "outp", "xa", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * Wi, L)
    n.M("M13", "outn", "xb", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wi, L)
    n.M("M14", "outn", "xb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * Wi, L)

    # ---- first-order predictions (calibrated against iteration-1 simulation) ----
    oin = lut.op("n", Win, L, 0.65, 0.6)
    ot = lut.op("n", Wt, L, 1.8, 0.15)
    itail = min(2 * oin["Id"], ot["Id"]) if ot["Id"] > 0 else 2 * oin["Id"]
    on = lut.op("n", Wln, L, 0.9, 0.9)
    op_ = lut.op("p", Wlp, L, 0.9, 0.9)
    oi_n = lut.op("n", Wi, L, 0.9, 0.9)
    oi_p = lut.op("p", 2 * Wi, L, 0.9, 0.9)
    cgu = 1.2e-15
    cP = (0.5 * Win + 0.5 * Wln) * cgu
    cX = (0.6 * Wln + 0.6 * Wlp + 0.5 * Wr) * cgu + on["cgg"] + op_["cgg"] + oi_n["cgg"] + oi_p["cgg"]
    gml = on["gm"] + op_["gm"]
    t_int = (2 * cP * 0.3 + 2 * cX * 0.5) / max(itail, 1e-6)
    gm_in = oin["gm"]
    av = max(gm_in * t_int / max(cX, 1e-16), 1.0)
    tau = cX / max(gml, 1e-6)
    t_reg = tau * math.log(max(VDD / (av * dv), 2.0))
    t_inv = 0.69 * (cl + 2e-15) / max(oi_p["gm"], 1e-6) * 2
    delay = 0.19 * (t_int + t_reg + t_inv)
    energy = 1.37 * (2 * cP * 0.9 + 1.5 * cX * VDD + (cl + 2 * Wi * cgu) * VDD + 0.5 * Wt * cgu * VDD) * VDD
    return n, {"correct": 1, "delay": delay, "energy": energy}
```
